I am too old to be carrying heavy bags of chemical fertilizer, and beans have always grown well enough with the manure from my cattle. I will plant the same local beans I have saved from last season because I know they do well here in Mzimba. I do not have money for pesticides or irrigation, so my family will weed by hand when the rains come, and I will hire a few young men to help with the planting and harvesting because my back is not what it used to be.
